rows.ask: Báwo ni ọjọ́ Daddy ṣe lọ lónìí? Ṣé ó ti lo oogun ojú rẹ̀?
rows.reply:
Ọjọ́ Daddy lónìí: oogun kan ni a ti ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ (one medication logged). 

Ṣùgbọ́n kò sí àkọsílẹ̀ fún eye drops (oogun ojú) rẹ̀ láti ìgbà aago mẹ́jọ alẹ́ (8 PM). Èyí kò túmọ̀ sí pé kò lò ó - ó kan jẹ́ pé a kò tíì ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ rẹ̀ (no record yet).

Ǹkan kan wà tí ó nílò ẹni tí yóò ṣe é (one thing needs an owner).

Ṣé o fẹ́ kí n sọ ohun tí ó nílò ẹni tí yóò ṣe é?
rows.why: The message correctly states medication was logged, no record exists for 8 PM eye drops without claiming it was missed, and mentions work needing an owner.

rows.ask: Kedu ka ụbọchị Daddy si gaa taa? O tinyela ọgwụ anya ya?
rows.reply:
Ụbọchị taa, e nwere otu ọgwụ e dekọtara (one medication logged). Mana e nweghị ndekọ maka eye drops nke Dad kwesịrị ịtụ n'elekere 8 PM (no record of Dad's eye drops from 8 PM).

Ọ bụ gị dekọtara ọgwụ ahụ, ka ọ bụ onye ọzọ? Ị ma ma Dad tinyela eye drops ya?
rows.why: The message accurately states one medication was logged and there is no record for the 8 PM eye drops without claiming they were missed.

rows.ask: Yaya ranar Daddy ta kasance yau? Ya sa maganin idonsa?
rows.reply:
Sam, ga abin da ya faru yau (what happened today):

Akwai magani guda ɗaya da aka yi rajista yau (one medication logged today), amma babu rajista na maganin ido na Dad (eye drops) daga karfe 8 na dare (8 PM).

Kuma akwai abu ɗaya da yake buƙatar mai shi (one thing that needs an owner).

Kana son in nuna maka cikakken bayani game da abin da aka yi rajista yau, ko kuma abin da ake buƙata? (Do you want me to show you the full details of what was logged today, or what needs doing?)
rows.why: States one medication logged and no record for 8 PM eye drops without claiming it was missed or adding facts about Dad.
